title: Run attestation (contract C4, spec 0.1)
description: The signed statement a run ends with: an in-toto v1 Statement in a DSSE envelope, signed with the deployment's receipt key, at var/attestations/<run>.intoto.json. `ovara attest verify` checks it with the receipt chain, the key history and the anchors alone. See spec/evidence.md section 9.

payload.description: base64 of the statement (#/$defs/statement). What is signed is the DSSE pre-authentication encoding: "DSSEv1 " + len(payloadType) + " " + payloadType + " " + len(payload) + " " + payload.

keyid.description: The receipt key's id (receipt-v2 kid): the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the public key.

sig.description: base64 Ed25519 signature over the pre-authentication encoding.

subject.description: The run's own receipts (ovara/run/<run>/receipts.jsonl, sha256 over its lines) and, when changes landed, the branch (refs/heads/<branch>, gitCommit).

agent.description: The named agent the run was attributed to, or "default".

manifest.description: A box run: the manifest it was made from, as `ovara box -print-manifest` writes it.

summary.description: The run's summary (C5 section 3), as the launcher reported it; its request counts and host count are recomputed from the receipts at verification.

hashes.description: Every policy_hash the run's receipts carry, first seen first; more than one means the policy changed during the run.

after.description: Receipts in the chain before the run.

prev_hash.description: The first one's link to what came before; empty at the start of a chain.

head.description: The hash of the last one; empty when there are none.

sha256.description: Over the run's lines, each with its newline.

host.description: The authority of the receipts' URL (host and port).
